Below the screen and speakers are hanging green plants. In the foreground, there is a desk area with various items including a coffee maker and bottles.

The image projected on the screen appears slightly smeared and lacks the crisp pixel structure expected from a digital projection, appearing more like a painted texture than a light projection.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the speaker pairs. AI often struggles with identical complex objects placed symmetrically. Check if the left and right speakers are mirror images or exact duplicates, which might indicate copy-paste artifacts. Also, scrutinize the connection points where the speakers meet the wall for any signs of 'melting' or lack of physical mounting brackets.
